notes.subject: fix(execute_command): tell protected-git native retries to drop the sandbox terminal target
notes.summary: Protected-git recovery guidance now tells callers to omit terminal_id, terminal_name and split_from on the native retry, since the sandbox terminal cannot run native commands.

notes.subject: fix(server): kill leftover command process-group jobs on exit, not close
notes.summary: The assistant server now kills leftover background jobs in a command's process group when the command exits, so commands no longer hang when a job keeps the output pipes open.
